brand_identity.name: Balcony Originals
brand_identity.tagline: Stories rooted in culture. Told for the world.
brand_identity.ethos: An independent cinematic production house dedicated to devotional, cultural, heritage, and tourism documentaries alongside visionary feature films and raw story submissions.
brand_identity.emotional_tone: Cinematic, revered, moody, authoritative, artistic, intimate, timeless
brand_identity.aesthetic_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & EDITORIAL CINEMA (Near-black obsidian charcoal, antique gold, film grain, corner frame crosshairs, asymmetric typography)

hierarchy_rules.section_heading: text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight text-[#F2EDE4]

visual_enhancers.film_grain: CSS repeating SVG/noise canvas overlay with pointer-events-none opacity-[0.04]
visual_enhancers.viewfinder_frames: Corner frame ticks (+ or L-shaped borders) on main hero and feature cards with technical camera metadata overlay (e.g. 24FPS • 35MM • ISO 400 • RAYALASEEMA)

navigation.features: Brand logo with gold accent mark, primary links (Home, Works, Documentaries, Feature Films, Development, Submit Story, About, Contact), audio reel toggle button, full-screen mobile menu drawer with smooth framer-motion stagger

hero_webgl.type: Interactive Three.js particle field with light beams and atmospheric fog
hero_webgl.elements: 3D gold light particles, interactive camera tilt on mouse move, skippable brand intro loader animation (Sony/Awwwards style countdown frame numbers + logo reveal), masked headline reveal ('Stories Rooted in Culture. Told for the World.')

chapters: 01. The Red Soil of Rayalaseema - Heritage, Forts, and Forgotten Myths
02. Devotional Echoes - Temples, Sacred Chants, and Ritual Documentaries
03. Visionary Cinema - High-Impact Feature Films with Regional Soul
04. Global Canvas - Taking Indigenous Indian Oral Traditions Worldwide

featured_work.items: Streaming-style hero cards with hover poster zoom, video trailer preview on hover, project tags, duration, director notes, award badges

documentaries_stream.detail_page_features: Full-bleed hero banner with sound preview trigger, synopsis, episode/part guide, crew credits, high-res photo gallery, related documentaries carousel, stream request form modal

feature_films.detail_page_features: Logline, cast & crew list, director statement, press reviews, trailer video overlay embed, release calendar

upcoming_in_development.type: Production Slate / Kanban View & Project Cards
upcoming_in_development.features: Investment / Co-production enquiry button for each project

story_submission_page.headline: 'Stories Are Gems' - Submit Your Original Story
story_submission_page.features: Interactive feedback modal, submission tracking status simulation

about_page.features: Founders' story, Rayalaseema location spotlight, production gear setup, artistic manifesto, press mentions, award highlights

contact_page.office_location: Anantapur & Tirupati, Rayalaseema, Andhra Pradesh, India

not_found_404.features: Cinematic film strip effect, 404 scene frame, Return to Home button (data-testid='404-go-home-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute full implementation using React js, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Framer Motion, and Three.js.
Import Marcellus, Archivo, and Noto Serif Telugu fonts in index.html/index.css.
Implement the cinematic skippable brand intro loader (Sony film countdown style).
Ensure every page and component has exact data-testid attributes.
Build the complete site: Home, Works Archive, Documentary Detail, Feature Film Detail, Upcoming Slate, Story Submission ('Stories Are Gems'), About, Contact, and 404.
Incorporate Apple TV style streaming cards with video preview modal capability for documentary detail pages.
Ensure the story submission form provides interactive feedback, validation, and confirmation state.
